name: Brickell Buick GMC
climate: Hot, humid South Florida: strong sun, heat, heavy rain, hurricane season and flood risk. No snow, road salt or winter driving.
brandNaming: Write the store name as "Brickell Buick GMC" (the site's structured data and DDC title suffix); some site page names say "Brickell Buick & GMC", but use one form per article
Name the brands "Buick" and "GMC" (GMC in capitals); GM (General Motors) is the parent company

Use the model and trim casing the dealer site uses: Envista, Encore GX, Envision, Enclave; Terrain, Acadia, Yukon, Yukon XL, Canyon, Sierra 1500, Sierra HD, Sierra EV, HUMMER EV; trims Preferred, Sport Touring and Avenir (Buick), Elevation, AT4, AT4X and Denali (GMC)
Dealer service is "Certified Service" (GM's dealer-service name, approved for this store 08/10/2026); articles do not call technicians factory-trained, "certified technicians" or master technicians
Do not name a parts brand for this store: no "GM Genuine Parts" and no "ACDelco" (no parts brand is approved; both live articles had it removed)
GM's oil-change reminder is the "Engine Oil Life System" and the oil specification is "dexos1 Gen 3" (lowercase dexos); never say other oils void the warranty
"Super Cruise" is GM's hands-free driver-assistance name: say availability varies by model and trim, and give no package pricing

maintainerNotes: Parts: the site shows only a toll-free parts number, (855) 662-8985, so no parts phone is printed. Ask the dealer for a local parts line.
